source: Ticket 238 and #142 'Before contact': a cracked shell for dynamite, a hard dark rim for the drill (open, glinting, once the tip of the last completed major cuts it), and one slow surface motion per extractor, from #142's extraction-rig table. A signature cell's marker takes its act's rim tint from #151's per-theme palette (Planet & Narrative, adopted by the Game Director); #151 names the tints, the hex values here are starting values for art. #151's hue-collision rule sends a rim within hueCollisionDeg of the family's hue to the theme's secondary colour, and a rim inside the reserved heat hues (#151 'Reserved colours', #142 'No orange' on the extractor marker) takes the secondary too, which is why Fire wears char red, not ember orange. The motion names are the kernel's terrain patterns (src/systems/render/gatePatterns.ts, ticket 299), which draw them in the ground.
